objective_pt: Comparar produtos, lugares e opções com comparativos e superlativos ("cheaper than", "more comfortable", "the best") e dizer qual você prefere e por quê.

teacher.goal_pt: Comparar duas coisas do dia a dia e introduzir "-er than".
prompts: Which is better, coffee or tea?
Is your city bigger or smaller than Rio?
watchFor: "Bigger that" ou "bigger of"; depois do comparativo vem "than".

exercises.prompt: The train is faster than the bus.
accepted: The train is faster than the bus
The train's faster than the bus

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivo curto ganha "-er": "faster", e não "more fast".
commonErrors.correction_en: The train is faster than the bus.

exercises.explanation_pt: "Good" é irregular: "good, better, the best". O mesmo com "bad, worse, the worst".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "São Paulo é maior do que o Rio."
accepted: São Paulo is bigger than Rio
Sao Paulo is bigger than Rio
São Paulo is larger than Rio
Sao Paulo is larger than Rio
São Paulo's bigger than Rio
São Paulo is bigger than Rio de Janeiro
Sao Paulo is bigger than Rio de Janeiro

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Big" é curto: o comparativo é "bigger" (dobra o "g"), sem "more".
commonErrors.correction_en: São Paulo is bigger than Rio.
São Paulo is bigger than Rio.
São Paulo is bigger than Rio.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender adjetivos para comparar: cheap, expensive, comfortable, crowded, quiet, worse, as... as.
prompts: Is it cheaper to eat at home or at a restaurant?
Which is more comfortable, a bus or a car?
What's the most crowded place in your city?
watchFor: "Comfortable" com quatro sílabas fortes ("com-for-TÁ-bol"); em inglês é "KUMF-ta-bol".

exercises.example_en: This phone is cheaper than that one.
The beach is more crowded on weekends.
My new apartment isn't as big as my old one.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Este hotel é mais caro do que aquele."
accepted: This hotel is more expensive than that one
This hotel is more expensive than that hotel
This hotel is more expensive than that
This hotel's more expensive than that one
This hotel costs more than that one

commonErrors.correction_en: This hotel is more expensive than that one.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o "than" fraco ("dhan", com a língua entre os dentes) e a pronúncia curta de "comfortable".
prompts: Say "comfortable". How many syllables do you hear?
watchFor: Dizer "than" como "dan" ou "zan"; o "th" aqui é sonoro, com a língua entre os dentes.
"Comfortable" com o "or" forte; o natural é "KUMF-ta-bol".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "th" de "than" é sonoro: língua entre os dentes e a garganta vibrando.
exercises.prompt: My sister is older than me.
accepted: My sister is older than me
My sister is older than I am
My sister's older than me

commonErrors.correction_en: My sister is older than me.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Comfortable" soa "KUMF-ta-bol": três sílabas, força no começo.
exercises.prompt: This sofa is more comfortable than the old one.
accepted: This sofa is more comfortable than the old one
This sofa's more comfortable than the old one

exercises.instruction_pt: Em qual sílaba fica a força de "comfortable"?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Comfortable" tem a força no começo e, na fala, o "or" quase some: "KUMF-ta-bol".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma comparação entre opções e responder qual você prefere e por quê.
prompts: Which do you prefer, the city or the countryside?
What's the best restaurant you know?
watchFor: "I prefer the city than the countryside"; com "prefer" usamos "to": "I prefer the city to the countryside".
"The best of the city"; com lugar usamos "in": "the best in the city".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha qual apartamento o Leo prefere e por quê.
exercises.listen: The first apartment is bigger, but the second one is cheaper and closer to my office. So I prefer the second one.
options: O segundo, porque é mais barato e mais perto do escritório.
O segundo, porque é maior e mais novo.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Cheaper and closer to my office": mais barato e mais perto do escritório. O primeiro é maior, mas ele prefere o segundo.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você prefere o trem, porque é mais rápido.
exercises.listen: Which do you prefer, the bus or the train?
accepted: I prefer the train because it's faster
I prefer the train because it is faster
I prefer the train. It's faster
The train, because it's faster
The train. It's faster
I'd prefer the train because it's faster
I prefer the train because it's quicker
The train, because it's quicker
I like the train better because it's faster

commonErrors.correction_en: I prefer the train because it's faster.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "because it is faster" (ou "because it's faster").
commonErrors.correction_en: I prefer the train because it's faster.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que é o mais bonito do mundo (use "the most beautiful").
exercises.listen: What do you think of Rio de Janeiro?
accepted: I think it's the most beautiful city in the world
It's the most beautiful city in the world
I think it is the most beautiful city in the world
It's the most beautiful place in the world
I think it's the most beautiful place in the world
In my opinion, it's the most beautiful city in the world
It's the most beautiful city in the world, I think

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No superlativo, "do mundo" vira "in the world".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's the most beautiful city in the world.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivo longo: "the most beautiful" no superlativo.
commonErrors.correction_en: It's the most beautiful city in the world.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "It's the most beautiful...".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's the most beautiful city in the world.

teacher.goal_pt: Comparar duas opções reais (dois celulares, duas cidades, dois empregos) e justificar a escolha.
prompts: Which is better, living in a house or in an apartment? Why?
Compare your city with another city you know.
What's the best thing you bought this year?
watchFor: "I prefer X than Y" em vez de "I prefer X to Y".
"The same of" em vez de "the same as".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Este é o melhor restaurante da cidade."
accepted: This is the best restaurant in the city
This is the best restaurant in town
This is the best restaurant in the town
This is the best restaurant in this city
It's the best restaurant in the city
This restaurant is the best in the city
This restaurant is the best in town

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No superlativo com lugar usamos "in": "the best restaurant in the city".
commonErrors.correction_en: This is the best restaurant in the city.
This is the best restaurant in the city.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O melhor" de todos é o superlativo "the best". "Better" compara só dois.
commonErrors.correction_en: This is the best restaurant in the city.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Meu celular novo não é tão bom quanto o antigo."
accepted: My new phone isn't as good as my old one
My new phone is not as good as my old one
My new phone isn't as good as the old one
My new cell phone isn't as good as my old one
My new phone isn't as good as my old phone
My new mobile isn't as good as my old one
My new phone is worse than my old one
My new phone's not as good as my old one

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tão... quanto" é "as... as": "not as good as".
commonErrors.correction_en: My new phone isn't as good as my old one.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A estrutura é "as... as", com "as" nos dois lados.
commonErrors.correction_en: My new phone isn't as good as my old one.
My new phone isn't as good as my old one.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a frase.
accepted: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning
In the morning I prefer tea to coffee

exercises.instruction_pt: A Sam está em dúvida entre duas cidades para as férias. Compare duas opções e dê a sua recomendação.
exercises.prompt_en: I can't decide where to go on vacation: a big city or a small town on the beach. Which one is better, in your opinion? Why?
guidelines_pt: Compare as duas com pelo menos 2 comparativos: "The city is more exciting, but the beach town is cheaper."
Use um superlativo: "The best thing about... is...".
Dê a sua recomendação: "I think you should go to... because...".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as regras do comparativo e do superlativo, incluindo os irregulares.
prompts: What's the worst food you ever tried?
Who is the tallest person in your family?
watchFor: "The most big" em vez de "the biggest".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O trânsito hoje está pior do que ontem."
accepted: The traffic is worse today than yesterday
Traffic is worse today than yesterday
The traffic today is worse than yesterday
Today the traffic is worse than yesterday
The traffic is worse today than it was yesterday
Today's traffic is worse than yesterday's

commonErrors.correction_en: The traffic is worse today than yesterday.
The traffic is worse today than yesterday.
The traffic is worse today than yesterday.

exercises.sentence: This is the ___ shop in the mall.
accepted: cheapest

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Cheap" é curto: o superlativo é "the cheapest".
commonErrors.correction_en: This is the cheapest shop in the mall.

options: Today is more hot than yesterday.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Hot" é curto e termina em consoante-vogal-consoante: dobra o "t" e ganha "-er": "hotter than".

exercises.prompt: It's not the cheapest, but it's the best.
accepted: It's not the cheapest, but it's the best
It isn't the cheapest, but it's the best
It is not the cheapest, but it is the best
